Implemented the fix in `hooks/src/index.js:236`.

The hooks-generated `shouldComponentUpdate` now re-renders when the component receives new props, even if its batched state updates net back to the original value. This prevents prop updates from being discarded when state is set and reverted on the same tick.

Validation:
- `useState` failing test now passes.
- All 111 hooks tests pass.
- All 246 compat tests pass.
- Full browser suite: 1002 passed; only an unrelated headless-Chrome focus/capture event test fails.
